description: Header file defining the ProxyConfigServiceAndroid class for Android proxy configuration management, including JNI interactions, proxy override rules, and observer pattern implementation.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of proxy configuration service, handling proxy override rules, JNI callbacks, and observer management.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::JNIDelegate
classes.description: Interface for JNI callbacks related to proxy settings changes.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroid::ProxyOverrideRule
classes.description: Structure representing a proxy override rule with scheme and proxy URL.

methods.name: set_exclude_pac_url
methods.description: Enables or disables ignoring the PAC URL and using a local proxy.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: SetProxyOverride
methods.description: Sets proxy override rules and bypass rules, with optional callback upon completion.
